insights.observation: Packed entity iteration with sparse lookup separates traversal from identity maintenance.
insights.proof_or_validation_needed: Universal sparse/packed inverse invariants, component-intersection membership maintenance under every command, canonical logical-state codecs and full query/action preservation are still required for automatic replacement. Benchmarks show the index pays off for sparse query-heavy histories and regresses dense/churn histories; selection requires comparable held-out evidence.
insights.status: Explicit packed and maintained-intersection source algorithms, portable conformance and pinned EnTT/Flecs lifecycle adapters in bench/ecs-lifecycle; no automatic representation rewrite admitted

insights.observation: Transform propagation tracks changed components and dirty trees.
insights.proof_or_validation_needed: Skipping work requires checked dependencies, invalidation and preservation under parent changes; the current kernel always propagates the full forest.
insights.status: source study; not an admitted new rewrite
